让自然与生活，自由相连。: Make room for nature in your life.
在更广阔的空间，安放想象。: Give your imagination room to grow.
选择一处空间，从第一件家具开始。: Choose a space. Start with your first piece of furniture.
从空房开始，或让风格样板间给你一点灵感。: Start fresh, or take inspiration from a furnished home.
自由布置 · 真实尺度 · 沉浸漫游: Arrange freely · True scale · Walk inside
当前作品已达500件，请先移除部分家具。: This design has reached 500 items. Remove an item to add more.
附近没有足够空间，请先移动视角或整理家具。: No space nearby. Move the view or rearrange some furniture.
这里放不下这件家具，请拖到绿色提示的位置。: This item will not fit here. Drag it to a green placement area.
这个位置会与墙体或家具重叠。: This position overlaps a wall or another item.
已移除家具，可撤销恢复: Item removed. Undo to restore it.
本机存储空间不足或不可用，请导出作品备份。: Local storage is full or unavailable. Export your design as a backup.
本机保存失败，请导出作品备份。: Local save failed. Export your design as a backup.
作品包已导出，包含使用中的自定义模型: Design exported, including the custom models in use.
请先进入作品对应的住宅，再导入此作品。: Open the matching home before importing this design.
请填写0.05到10米之间的宽度。: Enter a width between 0.05 and 10 metres.
模型尺寸过大，请减小宽度。: The model is too large. Reduce its width.
换个分类，或导入自己的模型。: Try another category or import your own model.
拖进房间摆放，也可以点击添加。: Drag into a room, or click to add.
选一个房间，靠近看看。: Choose a room to take a closer look.
W A S D 移动 · 眼高 1.6m · 点击画面转向 · Esc 返回: W A S D to move · Eye height 1.6m · Click to look · Esc to return
拖动家具摆放 · 空白处旋转 · 滚轮缩放: Drag items to place · Drag empty space to orbit · Scroll to zoom
作品只保存在此浏览器。: Your design is saved in this browser.
导出一份，带去下一台设备。: Export a copy to take it to another device.
导入自包含GLB文件，模型保存在你的浏览器中。: Import a self-contained GLB file. Models stay in your browser.
选择空房重新开始，或恢复当前风格的样板间。此操作可以撤销。: Start with an empty home or restore the original furnished layout. You can undo this.
你可以在3D视角布置家具，或走进房间感受实际尺度。: Arrange furniture in 3D, or walk inside to experience the space at true scale.
已切换为空房，可以撤销恢复: Empty home ready. Undo to restore your layout.
在空白处按住鼠标左键拖动: Hold the left mouse button and drag empty space.
点家具库添加，然后拖动摆放: Drag a card into the layout, or click to add and then move it.
R 旋转 · ⌘ / Ctrl + D 复制: R to rotate · ⌘ / Ctrl + D to duplicate
⌘ / Ctrl + Z · 加 Shift 重做: ⌘ / Ctrl + Z · Add Shift to redo
切换漫游，WASD移动，点击画面转向: Choose Walk, use WASD to move and click the view to look around.
按 Esc 返回3D视角: Press Esc to return to the 3D view.
使用 Quest 浏览器打开网站并进入VR: Open the site in a Quest browser and choose Enter VR.
导出作品包，再到另一台设备导入: Export your design and import it on another device.
这不是受支持的 Dwellcraft 作品。: This is not a supported Dwellcraft design.
作品中的家具数据无效。: The design contains invalid furniture data.
模型超过50MB，请先压缩后再导入。: The model exceeds 50MB. Reduce its size before importing.
请选择有效的 GLB 2.0 单文件模型。: Choose a valid single-file GLB 2.0 model.
模型结构信息无效或过大。: The model structure is invalid or too large.
模型结构信息无法读取。: The model structure could not be read.
模型结构过于复杂，请简化节点、材质与贴图。: The model is too complex. Simplify its nodes, materials and textures.
请把模型与贴图全部嵌入GLB，不能引用外部文件。: Embed all model data and textures in the GLB. External files are not supported.
此模型需要尚未支持的压缩或扩展，请导出普通GLB后再试。: This compression or extension is not supported. Export a standard GLB and try again.
模型节点引用无效。: The model contains an invalid node reference.
模型必须使用三角形网格。: The model must use triangle meshes.
模型需包含网格，且总三角面不能超过20万。: The model must contain a mesh with no more than 200,000 triangles in total.
模型缺少内嵌二进制数据。: The model is missing embedded binary data.
当前支持内嵌 PNG、JPEG 或 WebP 贴图。: Embedded PNG, JPEG and WebP textures are supported.
模型贴图资源无效。: The model texture resource is invalid.
模型贴图数据不完整。: The model texture data is incomplete.
模型内的贴图无法解码。: A model texture could not be decoded.
单张贴图不能超过4096 × 4096。: Each texture must be no larger than 4096 × 4096.
有自定义模型丢失，请重新导入该模型后再导出。: A custom model is missing. Reimport it before exporting.
作品模型合计超过150MB，请减少模型后导出。: Models exceed 150MB in total. Remove some before exporting.
作品包资源过大或文件结构不受支持。: The package is too large or has an unsupported file structure.
作品清单无法读取。: The design manifest could not be read.
作品包版本不受支持。: This design package version is not supported.
自定义模型信息无效。: The custom model information is invalid.
作品包缺少自定义模型。: A custom model is missing from the package.
模型校验失败，作品包中的模型与清单不一致。: Model verification failed. The package does not match its manifest.
作品引用了未打包的模型。: The design references a model missing from the package.
模型文件不在此浏览器中，请重新导入作品包。: The model is not in this browser. Reimport the design package.
已选中：指向地面再次按扳机放置。: Selected. Point at the floor and press the trigger again to place.
这里与墙体或家具重叠，请换个位置。: This overlaps a wall or furniture. Choose another position.
此设备暂不支持沉浸式VR，请使用 Quest 3 / 3S 的浏览器打开。: Immersive VR is unavailable on this device. Open the site in a Quest 3 / 3S browser.
把{name}拖到房间里 · 绿色可放置，红色有遮挡: Drag {name} into a room · Green: fits · Red: blocked
选择一个家，自由布置，让理想生活成为可以走进去的空间。: Choose a home, arrange it freely and walk into your ideal living space.
从家具库拖入布局，或点击添加后移动: Drag a card into the layout, or click to add and then move it.
请先退出VR，再使用家具库。: Exit VR before using the furniture library.
松开放置{name} · Esc取消: Release to place {name} · Esc to cancel
移动{name}到空地 · 避开墙体与家具 · Esc取消: Move {name} to a clear space · Avoid walls and furniture · Esc to cancel
点击或拖动家具，自动返回布置视角。: Click or drag furniture to return to the layout view.
拖进房间摆放，或点击自动添加并定位。触屏可轻点添加。: Drag into a room, or click to add and locate. On touchscreens, tap to add.
